321 MCP tools across 42 servers, 293 free.

Every safety label is checked against the code on every build, so one pasted profile runs 215 of them unattended.

three.ws/mcp-tools

This server is three of those tools.

three_balance and three_price read. three_burn signs on Solana mainnet, so it is labelled irreversible and will not run without confirm: true.

altText: A three.ws card reading '321 MCP tools. Every label checked.' beside a browser window showing the three.ws MCP Tool Catalog: counters reading 321 tools, 42 servers, 215 read-only, 81 writes, 25 irreversible, 293 free and 28 paid, above three permission profiles named Strict, Balanced and Open

A three.ws card reading 'Three tools. One of them burns.' beside a browser window showing the catalog filtered to the three-token-mcp server: three_balance and three_price each badged Read-only and Free, and three_burn badged Irreversible and Free, each with its full description

editor.summary: Every number in post 1 (321 tools, 42 servers, 293 free, 215 read-only) is verified against the live page and matches the attached frame, and post 2's three_burn claims are confirmed by both the page and source file. Voice is clean throughout: no hype, no dashes, mechanism in the first line, link present, and both images are sharp real-product captures with accurate alt text. Ship it.
